idea-plugin.name: Compose Gallery
idea-plugin.description:
Browse your Jetpack Compose previews directly inside Android Studio. The Compose Gallery Gradle plugin discovers every annotated @Preview, renders high-quality thumbnails using Layoutlib, and generates metadata consumed by this IntelliJ plugin. The Gallery groups previews by component, supports multiple preview variants (device, locale, theme, font scale, etc.), and lets you jump directly to the corresponding composable source.

Generate the gallery by running: 
./gradlew generateGallery
Then open the Compose Gallery tool window.
